value.body: Anthropology as a major studies human beings in two broad strands: social and cultural anthropology (kinship, religion, tribes and communities) and biological or physical anthropology (human evolution, genetics and variation). Fieldwork among communities is a core part of training, and some universities also teach archaeological and forensic anthropology.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Central and many other universities admit through CUET-UG; others admit on Class 12 marks or their own test. Relatively few universities teach anthropology, and some offer it in a B.Sc (with more biology) as well as a B.A.

value.title: At a glance
items: A small subject — check which colleges near you offer it before planning around it.
Anthropology is an optional subject in the UPSC Civil Services exam.
Fieldwork and qualitative-research skills carry into development-sector, social-research and market-research work.
Research and teaching posts usually need a master's, and often UGC-NET or a Ph.D.
